title: Israeli strikes kill at least four in Gaza, including a Hamas internal security member and a teenage girl
detail: Gaza health and security officials say Israeli strikes killed at least four people on Nov 3, among them a Hamas internal security member in a strike on a tent near Khan Younis and a teenage girl killed by a drone strike in Gaza City. The IDF said separately that strikes in northern Gaza killed four Hamas operatives, one it says took part in the Oct 7 attack; Hamas has not confirmed those identities. A Hamas spokesperson called Gaza's streets 'corridors of death' and urged the Board of Peace and envoy Nickolay Mladenov to press Israel to stop. Gaza health officials count more than 1,500 killed since the October 2025 truce.
